NCQ_AdrenalineOverdose_desc:
Hijacks the target's combat-stim injectors and dumps the whole reservoir. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">15 seconds</> they <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">go berserk beyond control</> - ignoring cover and attacking whatever is closest, their own squad included.

Nobody carries that load for long: they <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">lose health every second</>, and when the surge drops they are left spent and wide open.
NCQ_AdrenalineOverdose_sedesc: Synthetic adrenaline flooding. Cardiovascular strain critical.
NCQ_AdrenalineOverdose_short: Force the injectors open. Uncontrolled berserk, and the heart pays for it.
NCQ_CryptoSiphon_desc:
Plants a stealth worm on the target's personal shard. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">30 seconds</> it quietly drains <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">eddies every second</> into your account.

Kill them while the worm is still resident and it runs a <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">bankruptcy protocol</>, dumping the remainder of their balance to you - larger the longer you let them live.

Non-lethal and untraceable.
NCQ_CryptoSiphon_sedesc: Stealth worm resident on personal shard. Funds draining.
NCQ_CryptoSiphon_short: Worm their shard. Drains eddies while they live, dumps the account if they die.
NCQ_MotorCortex_desc:
A localized disruptor on the motor cortex. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">10 seconds</> the target <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">desyncs from real time</> - movement turns sluggish and jerky, aim falls apart, weapon handling goes to pieces.

Turns an armored shooter into dead weight without killing them.
NCQ_MotorCortex_sedesc: Motor cortex desynced. Movement and aim unreliable.
NCQ_MotorCortex_short: Scramble spatial awareness. They desync from real time and stop hitting anything.
NCQ_OpticOverwrite_desc:
Rewrites the <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">IFF tags</> the target broadcasts to their own squad. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">15 seconds</> every ally within 30m reads them as a Militech operative and <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">opens fire</>.

The target fires back. You take no part in the exchange - <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">no attention comes your way</>.

Every tag is restored when the hack ends.
NCQ_OpticOverwrite_sedesc: IFF tags spoofed. Reads as hostile to their own squad.
NCQ_OpticOverwrite_short: Spoof their IFF tags. Their own squad reads them as Militech and engages.
NCQ_PhantomOverlay_desc:
Uploads a fabricated optical contact straight into the target's visual cortex. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">12 seconds</> they and every ally within 35m see a body that is not there and <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">break formation to converge on it</>.

The phantom always projects away from your position. Untraceable.
NCQ_PhantomOverlay_sedesc: Optical feed compromised. Tracking a contact that does not exist.
NCQ_PhantomOverlay_short: Write a false optical contact into their feed. The squad breaks formation to engage it.
NCQ_ReflexJammer_desc:
Arms a <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">12-second</> desync trap on the target's reflex-booster bus. It does nothing until they try to use it.

The moment they trigger a <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">Sandevistan, Kerenzikov or combat dodge</>, a neural misfire goes off instead: <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">the time dilation is suppressed</>, they seize up, their armor collapses, and they take a burst of shock damage.

The more chrome they run, the harder it hits.
NCQ_ReflexJammer_sedesc: Reflex bus desynced. Any time-dilation attempt will misfire.
NCQ_ReflexJammer_short: Arms a desync trap. Fires when they next use Sandevistan, Kerenzikov or a dodge.
NCQ_SmartLinkScramble_desc:
Floods the target's smart-targeting co-processor with junk telemetry. For <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">10 seconds</> every homing round they fire <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">loses its lock on you</> and re-acquires the nearest body in view - usually someone from their own squad.

The squad never works out what happened and <Rich color="TooltipText.cyberwareDescriptionHighlightColor" style="Semi-Bold">will not return fire</>. Untraceable.
NCQ_SmartLinkScramble_sedesc: Smart-targeting co-processor corrupted. Homing fire will not acquire you.
NCQ_SmartLinkScramble_short: Corrupt smart-weapon targeting. Homing fire re-acquires their own squad.
